findings.claim: ADR-0016's own 'Per agent' table still lists Claude Code case B as `updatedInput` + `allow` (LV1). This is the exact mechanism the ADR's own 'r3 decisions' section (Q3), in the same file, says must never be used, because Claude Code ignores allow+updatedInput for Bash. The ADR contradicts itself, not just an older doc.
findings.evidence: docs/v2/adr/0016-subagent-context-protection.md:65 (Per agent table) "Claude Code | yes | `updatedInput` + `allow` (LV1) | `updatedToolOutput`..." directly below, same file, line ~85: "Q3: case B never uses `allow` + `updatedInput`. The deny reason carries the full rewritten wrapper command; the subagent runs it with its own Bash." DECISIONS-r3.md Q3 states the same rule and cites v1 commit 4bc292fc. Confirmed by git archaeology: `git log -1 4bc292fc` in cm-main shows commit 4bc292fca61252f515e902d30250e783765099cc, 'fix(hooks): claude-code Bash modify -> deny (CC ignores updatedInput.command)', message: 'CC v2.1.x Bash tool ignores updatedInput.command substitution under permissionDecision allow -- the original command runs unchanged. Only permissionDecision deny is honored for Bash blocking.'
findings.fix: Edit the ADR-0016 'Per agent' table row for Claude Code case B to 'deny + rewritten command in reason (Q3)', matching the Q3 section already in the same file, and re-run lint.mjs. The round-1/round-2 pass-A consistency findings (A1 tool count, A2 ADR-0014/Q18) did not catch this because they checked cross-file sync, not this within-file self-contradiction in ADR-0016 itself.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: 4bc292fca61252f515e902d30250e783765099cc, Sun May 31 2026, Mert Koseoglu, 'fix(hooks): claude-code Bash modify -> deny (CC ignores updatedInput.command)'. ORIGINAL_INTENT (commit message): 'Diagnosed via /diagnose Phase 4 forced-deny probe: CC v2.1.x Bash tool ignores updatedInput.command substitution under permissionDecision: allow -- the original command runs unchanged. Only permissionDecision: deny is honored for Bash blocking.' REGRESSION_RISK: high. If v2 ships case B as allow+updatedInput for Claude Code (per the stale table row), the rewrite silently does nothing, the original unrewritten command runs, and its full output floods the subagent's context -- the exact bug ADR-0016 exists to fix (the MUST). SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: case B for Claude Code must use deny with the reason carrying the rewritten command (never allow/updatedInput for Bash); keep the wrapper (run.mjs) mechanism; update only the table cell plus its LV1 citation, no other behavior change needed since the correct rule is already written elsewhere in the same ADR.
